parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ...$json, auto_publish: true, keywords: $('Data From User').item.json.keywords }) }}

parameters.jsonOutput:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  status: 'blocked',
  message: 'Payload AI tidak lolos validasi/editorial QA, publish dibatalkan.',
  slug: $json.slug || '',
  title: $json.title || '',
  topic: $('Parse Proposed Topic').item.json.topic || '',
  errors: $json._errors || [],
  qa: $json._qa || {},
  preview: $json._raw_preview || '',
  generated_at: $now.toISO()
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  status: $json.qa?.decision === 'publish' ? 'published' : 'draft_saved',
  message: $json.qa?.decision === 'publish'
    ? 'Artikel lolos QA dan langsung terbit.'
    : 'Artikel disimpan sebagai draft, perlu review di admin.',
  slug: $json.data?.slug || '',
  title: $('Ready To Publish?').item.json.title || '',
  topic: $('Parse Proposed Topic').item.json.topic || '',
  url: $json.data?.url || '',
  qa: $json.qa || {},
  is_published: $json.data?.is_published === true,
  saved_at: $now.toISO()
}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "notify_skipped", reason: "Telegram belum dikonfigurasi", payload: $json }) }}
